answer.original_source: Anthropic (party statement, relayed by campustechnology.com on 2026-07-01)
answer.new_information: Anthropic says Claude Science, launched in beta June 30, 2026, uses NVIDIA BioNeMo Agent Toolkit skills to connect to BioNeMo models and libraries, including Evo 2, Boltz-2, and OpenFold3. The record gives no revenue, adoption, pricing, or dollar figures, and no period or definition that maps to a financial question. The only NVIDIA-related item is an ecosystem integration announced by Anthropic, and NVIDIA's own announcement of the toolkit (June 23) is a separate record that is not stored here.
answer.reason: No questions are linked and the catalog is empty, so there is no argument to update. The record is a third-party software integration announced by Anthropic with no sizing, adoption metric, or financial effect on NVIDIA, which makes it context rather than a number, probability, or risk that would move an existing argument. It is not an investment judgement that a catalog question lacks, so no new question is proposed.
